source.source_locator: 燃焼の3要素／通常の燃焼

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 通常の燃焼では空気中の酸素が支燃物に当たる。
evidence.tested_misconception: 酸素の供給を減らす操作は可燃物を断つ操作である。
evidence.reasoning_path: identify ordinary combustion -> oxygen is supporter -> reduce air supply -> supporter becomes insufficient

collision.note: R2 remediation: source-defined application of the supporter element; distinct from C002 heat-removal boundary

independent_review.rationale: The FDMA Fire Research Institute explicitly defines the combustion elements and states that, in ordinary combustion, oxygen in air is the supporter. Restricting air inflow to reduce oxygen is a direct application of that proposition. The revised wording avoids unsupported extinguishing-method terminology.

director_adjudication.rationale: Independent review round 2 is adopted; the remediated source binding and collision evidence satisfy the AI-governed acceptance gate.
